text:
Priya (Content): Quick idea 14  - run a "micro-launch" for an OSS refapp + three how-tos + a short benchmark story. timeline: 2.5 weeks. Goal: build community momentum + collect leads for a deeper webinar. Thoughts?
Marco (DevRel): sounds good. I'll own the refapp repo and the reproducible perf script. Plan: single repo with 3 branches for each tutorial.
Sasha (Growth): routing note: prefer minimal friction signups. Typeform gated by email, with hidden utm fields. Then webhook to HubSpot -> tag as "oss_micro_launch".
Tania (Design): I can make 3 social cards + one walkthrough GIF. Need final hero copy by Wed EOD.
Omar (Ops): I'll set up the Zapier flow and a staging webhook. Also recommend a spam filter on the Typeform to catch bots.
Priya (Content): suggested tutorial topics: 1) Quickstart: text gen + streaming 2) Embeddings for search 3) Cost/perf tuning with batching + caching. Each a short MD + runnable example.
Marco (DevRel): agree. Also include a small benchmark harness: run 10 runs, return median latency, 95p latency, tokens/sec, cost estimate based on tokenization. I'll include a Dockerfile for reproducibility.
Sasha (Growth): messaging hook for hero: "Hands-on: ship an LLM feature with predictable performance." short, pragmatic. We'll A/B test CTA copy: "Try the refapp" vs "Join ambassador preview".
Tania (Design): leaning pragmatic too. I'll do a playful secondary line. Also can make an animated GIF showing latency numbers dropping with batching.
Priya (Content): deliverables + owners: Refapp + examples: @Marco. Tutorials (md + 3 short vids): @Priya & @Marco. Benchmark post: @Priya. Landing page + email copy: @Sasha. Graphics: @Tania. Zap + routing: @Omar.
Marco (DevRel): implementation note: example CLI to start: `npx redwood-starter run --example refapp-oss`. Will add CONTRIBUTING and issue template for ambassadors.
Omar (Ops): Zapier staging curl for webhook test:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/99999/zzzzz -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"qa@redwood.com","utm_campaign":"oss_micro_launch"}'
```
WebhookBot: Zap created (staging) -> Typeform catch endpoint 99999. Status: ready.
Sasha (Growth): field mapping: email -> contact.email, company -> contact.company (optional), utm_campaign -> contact.utm_campaign, tag -> oss_micro_launch. I'll add the mapping sheet link.
Priya (Content): benchmark storytelling: short narrative (500-700 words) that compares baseline (no batching, fp16) vs tuned (batching 8, KV cache, q4 quant). show cost/token delta and a config that balances latency and cost. Charts: latency CDF + cost per 1k tokens.
Marco (DevRel): I'll output CSV from the harness with columns: run_id, model, seq_len, batch_size, median_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, est_cost_usd. Good for plotting.
Tania (Design): assets needed: hero image (1200x628), three tutorial thumbnails, benchmark chart templates. Deliver first pass by Tue AM.
Omar (Ops): recommend UTM convention: utm_source=community, utm_medium=refapp, utm_campaign=oss_micro_launch_v1. Also add `utm_content` for CTA variant.
Sasha (Growth): CTA decision deadline: Fri noon. Will run quick H1 test for 48 hours.
Priya (Content): social plan: 3 tweets + 1 LinkedIn post + one devforum post. Each links to landing page and tutorial repo. Include short code snippet in social copy to entice clicks.
Marco (DevRel): for tutorials, I'll keep code snippets tiny. Example for embeddings: `python embed.py --text "quickstart"` and output vector printed.
Omar (Ops): access control: repo will be public, but refapp deploy key gated to a staging cluster. Need SRE signoff for live demo. Tagging @eng-sre separately.
Tania (Design): small ask: what tone for tutorial videos? screen recording with voiceover, casual technical. Keep each under 12 mins.
Priya (Content): yes casual + focused. We'll provide transcripts and short TL;DR highlights.
Sasha (Growth): lead nurture outline: immediate thank-you email with quickstart guide, day 3 deep-dive (benchmark story), day 7 invite to 30-min live demo. Track opens and clicks.
Marco (DevRel): adding a tiny badge for contributors: "Redwood Ambassador (micro-launch)" with SVG. Can issue via PR.
Omar (Ops): Zapier test passed at 2165432155. HubSpot contact created (staging).
WebhookBot: Test event received at 2165432155, forwarded to HubSpot staging.
Priya (Content): timeline check: week 1: infra + refapp + design. week 2: tutorials + benchmark post + landing page. week 2.5: launch + webinar signups + follow-up. Everyone add ETAs to the shared doc.
Sasha (Growth): sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/launch-micro-oss (internal). Added campaign steps.
Tania (Design): first bundles uploaded to #marketing-assets. Feedback welcome.
Marco (DevRel): pushed initial repo scaffold to Github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-micro (private until assets ready).
Priya (Content): I'll draft the benchmark post and PR in 5 days. Ping me if you need data columns or phrasing.
Omar (Ops): final checklist for launch: webhook live test -> landing page up -> tutorial repos public -> social assets ready -> SRE demo approval. I'll track and mark done.
Priya (Content): thanks team 389680. Let's reconvene Wed standup for a quick sync.
Sasha (Growth): noted. Will confirm CTA A/B and tagging.
Marco (DevRel): will add CONTRIBUTING and the badge generator.
Tania (Design): will iterate on the hero copy variations and post options.
WebhookBot: Reminder scheduled: Launch readiness check in 3 days at 10:00 AM.
